title: Disappointed in Quality
text: Disappointed in Quality. I haven't even put it together yet and I'm debating on whether I should. The very first piece I pulled out of the box was sloppy looking (pictures attached). The paint is cracked and it looks like we would need to caulk it for it to possibly look decent. This is the front drawer, so it's not like you won't see the piece. Disappointing because it looks nice in the pictures and most of the reviews are good. Maybe we just got a bad one.

description: Upgrade your home storage while adding classic style with the Elegant Home Fashions Blue Ridge Corner Wooden Floor Cabinet with Adjustable Shelves. This stylish storage solution features a white finish with a door that's decorated with cross-shaped molding and an acrylic pull for a timeless addition to your space. The 2 included adjustable glass shelves provide ample storage to reduce clutter and keep your home tidy. Constructed from durable engineered wood, this floor cabinet is built to provide you with long-lasting organization. Easy, step-by-step instructions and all of the hardware needed for installation are included for quick assembly. Purchase this stylish corner cabinet alone or with other items from the Blue Ridge collection for a cohesive, updated look. The Elegant Home Fashions Blue Ridge Corner Wooden Floor Cabinet with Adjustable Shelves measures 17.5" x 24.75" x 32" and fits easily into corners to provide accessible storage without taking up too much space in your living area or bathroom. Their customers include some of America's finest and most prestigious retailers, department stores, and discount retail chains. Elegant Home Fashions products have traveled the globe to focus on giving their consumers, the best quality and design for their bathroom decor.
